items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: Now later on, when I, with Fats, he was like one session was all music, that was Frank wrote.

ctx.x: Well how would Dave conduct a set?

He would say, I want this. Now if he had to sketch something out, he would, later on I believe he would sketch out a line. Me playing a baritone, I'd transpose, but a guy playing a piano would play the same thing. And that's how we did most of them, we'd write a line. Now later on, when I, with Fats, he was like one session was all music, that was Frank wrote. But during that time it was all head stuff. He said, Fats would start playing, or whoever it was, would start playing and he'd try a riff and say, what do…
Did you find Fats had a lot of creativity or would he rely on Dave a lot?
